review_improvement: Converts a help-only placeholder into a governed high-load run contract while preserving every named workload and telemetry parameter.
independent_technical_reasoning: An85% memory allocation plus FPU load stresses both DIMMs and CPU package, so errors and thermals cannot be attributed safely without synchronized PMM, die-temperature, ECC and OS telemetry. The AVT processes must be running and timestamp-aligned before AMDSST starts; losing telemetry invalidates safety coverage and must abort rather than permit an unattended eight-hour run.
